title: Form controls drawn as simulations
blurb: Five more controls from the ui-feed collection, rebuilt around native elements: a number input filled by a hand pump that obeys Boyle's law, radios on strings that vibrate, a rating of candles that light each other, a listbox with a probe that is captured into orbit, and a calendar with a bouncing ball. The simulation is stepped in the paint handler and stops when nothing moves.
question: Can the drawing of a native input be a running simulation (gas in a cylinder, a wave on a string, a flame, an orbit, a bouncing ball) while the input underneath stays the thing that is tapped, typed in, moved with the arrow keys and submitted?
result: Yes in the test browser for all five. The range under the pump handle had to have its own input events ignored while it is dragged, and a control that animates for ever (a flame) needs a frame limit. Nothing here is verified on a phone.
